action.name: ClearUseTarget
action.selector: ScriptArgs.Int(PlayerIndex,1) selects configured Player. Native unchecked vector access is not reproduced: unsupported conversion and unconfigured index reject explicitly.

order: Test cached target entity handle, separate from Thing.LifeStatus.
If entity valid, ScriptManager.OnActiveUseTargetLost(target,activeUnit). The cache is retained throughout callback dispatch.
Reload the cached pointer and Interact after callbacks. If CurrentUseTargetAnimation nonempty, call Thing.CancelAnimation(name).
Zero player target pointer and entity after the calls.
native_lifecycle.primary_restore: Only a nonnull actual primary whose AnimationData.Name equals the requested name is restored through SetAnimation(immutable ThingData.Graphic,false,true,false). Attached manager FX with that name are untouched.
native_lifecycle.callbacks: OnActiveUseTargetLost RVA0x28c040 supplies UserId when an active unit is present, AttachedTable from target actual Lua attachment, and AutoActivate only when target Interact still exists.

shared_consumers.automatic_clear: Missing/invalid active unit, no selected target or disabled input without UseableWhileInputDisabled invoke shared clear lifecycle.
shared_consumers.target_switch: Lost(old), Active(new), optional AutoUseFailedAnimation/OnAutoUseFailed, then assignment. Switch retains old cache during callbacks and does not restore old primary.
shared_consumers.post_use: After actual Interact.Use, virtual Thing.IsAlive false invokes ClearUseTarget.
shared_consumers.alive_state: LifeStatus byte+0x238==0. Object registry membership and entity generation remain independent until deferred disposal.

portable_ownership: Validate public ID plus lifetime and actual actor/screen ownership before native callback or primary access. Use copied keys across callbacks because genuine disposal can erase player cache entries.
verification_limits: Static matching DLL/PDB facts recovered. Parent coordinates fast strict original-input replay, exact held combat, final ASan/UBSan and Android/device checks; no child build or device operations.
